name: Materia Mundi
source: Materia Mundi Compendium, first edition. Page numbers refer to the Compendium PDF.

origins.name: Human Barbarian
origins.note: Chooses from the fey class list.

origins.name: Elf
origins.note: Elf champions always take the Mystic initiation.

origins.name: Beastfolk
origins.note: Beastfolk champions take an animal initiation matching their form.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.gear: Longsword, heavy armor, shield, dungeoneer's kit

features.name: Improved Critical Hit
features.summary: With an attack threshold of 9+ or better, beating it by 10 or more is a critical hit.

features.name: Fighter Feats
features.summary: Choose a fighter feat at levels 2, 4, 6 and 8.

classes.name: Scout
classes.gear: Light crossbow, two daggers, light armor, lockpicking tools, dungeoneer's kit

features.name: Scout's Expertise
features.summary: Climbing and hiding are easy; not while encumbered, in medium or heavy armor, or with a shield.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.summary: Use your ranged threshold against unaware targets; crit if every damage die beats your Stealth threshold.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.martial: No non-simple weapons or armor; armor hinders arcane magic
classes.gear: Spellbook, dagger, quarterstaff, robes, potion belt, dungeoneer's kit

features.name: Arcane Spellcasting
features.summary: Prepare spells from your spellbook at sunrise or sunset.

features.name: Cantrips
features.summary: Each prepared spell gives an at-will cantrip.

features.name: Arcane Rituals
features.summary: Cast spells up to half your level (round up) as rituals with Science checks.

classes.name: Priest
classes.gear: Quarterstaff, medium armor, prayer book, holy symbol, dungeoneer's kit

features.name: Divine Miracles
features.summary: Prepare miracles into prayer strips; choose a domain of faith.

features.name: Rebuking the Unholy
features.summary: Bearing check to drive back unholy creatures with fewer hit dice in a 5-pace cone.

features.name: Divine Rituals
features.summary: Perform miracles up to half your level (round up) as rituals with Bearing checks.

classes.name: Stalwart
classes.martial: All weapons, armor and shields; wield medium and heavy weapons as a medium creature
classes.gear: Ax, crossbow, heavy armor, shield, dungeoneer's kit

features.name: Improved Critical Hit
features.summary: With an attack threshold of 9+ or better, beating it by 10 or more is a critical hit.

features.name: Indefatigable
features.summary: Saves vs. Doom, Hold and Fear are easier.

features.name: Fighter's Feats
features.summary: Deflect Blows at 2, Defender at 4, then a feat of your choice at 6 and 8.

classes.name: Delver
classes.gear: Pickaxe, light crossbow, medium armor, potion belt, dungeoneer's kit

features.name: Armored Stealth
features.summary: Prepared medium armor does not penalize Stealth.

features.name: Stonesense
features.summary: Spend a turn tapping stone walls, then a Survival check maps 5 paces around you.

classes.name: Dweomersmith
classes.gear: Hammer, crossbow, heavy armor, potion belt, smith's tools, artisan's tools, dungeoneer's kit

features.name: Dweomercraft
features.summary: Craftbook with two alchemical formulae and two magic item blueprints; prepare dweomers at sunrise or sunset.

features.name: Dweomersmith Rituals
features.summary: Perform first-circle dweomers as rituals with Science checks.

classes.name: Champion
classes.martial: All weapons and shields, light armor only

features.name: Improved Critical Hit
features.summary: With an attack threshold of 9+ or better, beating it by 10 or more is a critical hit.

features.name: Battle-Trance
features.summary: Enter a trance on a melee attack; foes may be frightened, add level to melee damage.

features.name: Champion Initiation
features.summary: Choose an initiation (Mystic, Bear, Boar, Panther, Raven, Serpent, Shark, Wolf).

features.name: Hunter's Expertise
features.summary: Tracking and navigating are easy; befriend and train wild animals.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.summary: Use your ranged threshold against unaware targets; crit if every damage die beats your Stealth threshold.

classes.name: Bard
classes.gear: Two daggers, quarterstaff, medium armor, musical instrument

features.name: Magical Intuition
features.summary: Lore check to activate any magic item or prepared magic.

features.name: Bardsong
features.summary: Weave Dream or Song glamours into music with Charm checks.

classes.name: Druid
classes.martial: No non-simple weapons or armor; steel hinders primal magic
classes.gear: Quarterstaff, dagger, light armor, potion belt

features.name: Primal Druidcraft
features.summary: Start knowing four first-circle glamours or wild shapes; prepare from memory.

features.name: Wisps
features.summary: Invest a preparation in a wisp to cast an elemental glamour for you.

features.name: Primal Rituals
features.summary: Perform any known glamour as a ritual with Survival checks.

quickNpc.note: The printed table lists Wis as the Priest's prime; the Priest class (p. 16) says Cha, which is used here.
